shareable_copy.masked: 1 identity field(s) (the serial number; in an identity line of another layout, every field after the project name), each character replaced by 'X', and 0 Wi-Fi network name(s), each replaced by SSID01, SSID02, ... padded with '_' to its length (a shorter name by a shorter placeholder of the same length; empty names stay empty), in the capture's hex and ascii columns too; every message keeps its length. What the probe sent, and what it states about the firmware, are not changed
shareable_copy.not_importable: its facts cannot be bound to the robot: rung R1 imports the raw report, on the computer that ran the probe

allowlist_basis: read_only_commands: handlers disassembled in GFW 01.02.00 and found read-only; extended_commands: only with --extended and only on firmware newer than 01.02.00, NOT verified (no newer firmware image survives)

slot_roles.S1: 1st connection, expected firmware slot 0: commands are sent here; free-form replies, tower frames and direct replies to the requester (status blob, CAGE STATUS) arrive here
slot_roles.S2: 2nd connection, expected firmware slot 1: every INFO/ERR/WARN line (identity INFO;34, INFO;40, INFO;0 acknowledgements)
slot_roles.S3: 3rd connection, expected firmware slot 2: position frames

firmware_gate.rule: anything but the identity query (INFO) is sent only once the robot has identified itself as firmware 01.02.00 or newer; on older firmware, or an identity that is unreadable or contradictory, the probe sends nothing more in the whole run
